description: The time (minutes since midnight) given to a meal filed under a slot when it is not logged now: another day, or a slot picked by hand. A typical moment inside each band.

cases.why: Breakfast defaults to 08:00, inside its band, so the meal sorts first in the day.
Lunch defaults to 12:30, the middle of its band, which is the time most people mean.
Dinner defaults to 19:30, inside the 17:30-22:30 band, after any afternoon snack.
Snack defaults to 16:00, the afternoon gap: the round trip slot -> time -> slot must give snack back.
